accounting_connector.description: SAGA, ContabilTM, Xero, QuickBooks. Periodic sync.
accounting_connector.label: Accounting connector

alerts.description: Active alerts feed. Hidden behind DECISIONS_ALERTS_ENABLED.
alerts.label: Alerts

annual_billing.description: Yearly billing cycle at a discount. The /pricing toggle's Annual segment is disabled and labelled from THIS row — LR3 asserts the copy against this status, so promoting it here without wiring the cycle reds the gate.
annual_billing.label: Annual billing

anomaly_radar.description: Cross-period anomaly detection over the ledger. Backend is mounted ONLY when ANOMALY_RADAR_ENABLED is truthy (unset in production, where every /api/radar path is a 404 by construction); the pack-declared detector families carry a SECOND flag, RADAR_DETECTORS_ENABLED, so the surface can be enabled without them. This row is the frontend mirror of the first flag.
anomaly_radar.label: Anomaly Radar

ask_about_current_company.description: Opens the AI panel pre-loaded with the active period's context.
ask_about_current_company.label: Ask about current company

ask_cfo_ai.description: Universal Q&A grounded in the active period's statements + metrics.
ask_cfo_ai.label: Ask CFO AI

chat_page.description: The standalone /chat conversation surface. Distinct from `ask_cfo_ai`, which gates the in-context Capsule ask.
chat_page.label: Ask CFO AI (full chat page)

comprehensive_report.description: The full eight-section written analysis of a period as one document.
comprehensive_report.label: Comprehensive report

data_quality.description: Reconciliation gaps, missing accounts, classification warnings.
data_quality.label: Data quality checks

erp_connector.description: SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, Odoo. Connector framework.
erp_connector.label: ERP connector

firm_cockpit.description: Multi-client accounting-firm surface. Backend is mounted ONLY when FIRM_COCKPIT_ENABLED is truthy (unset in production), so every /api/firm route is a 404 there by construction; this row is the frontend mirror.
firm_cockpit.label: Firm Cockpit

forecast.description: The five-year plan as an interactive cockpit: the four numbers a bank asks for, one chart, sliders with their measured basis, three sourced cases and the reader's own; the full projected statements are its appendix. Every figure is PROJECTED and carries that marker in the payload.
forecast.label: Forecast

generate_90_day_plan.description: Sequenced action plan with owners and impact estimates.
generate_90_day_plan.label: Generate 90-day plan

generate_action_list.description: Exports the prioritized decision queue to CSV.
generate_action_list.label: Generate action list (CSV)

generate_bank_memo.description: Lender-style credit memo with covenants, leverage, DSCR.
generate_bank_memo.label: Generate bank memo

generate_board_summary.description: One-page executive memo synthesised from current statements.
generate_board_summary.label: Generate board summary

generate_public_report.description: Sanitised, sharable report safe for external distribution.
generate_public_report.label: Generate public report

import_history.description: Run log of every upload + reprocess event.
import_history.label: Import history

inventory.description: Superseded by Products (SKU-level stock detail) and the trial balance's own class-3 accounts. Anything unique folds into Products post-launch.

invoices.label: Receivables & Payables

manage_profile.description: Profile name, display name, language preference.

peer_report.description: P&L side by side with a named peer and the sector median.

products_legacy.description: Existing SKU page — reachable via /products redirect, folded under Inventory in nav.

upload_invoice.description: Bulk invoice ingest for AR/AP analytics.
upload_invoice.label: Upload invoice file
